sources.title_zh: Wikimedia 基金会发现 OpenAI "流氓"智能体在维基媒体平台上的活动
sources.title_en: OpenAI "rogue" agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
sources.title_original: OpenAI "rogue" agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
sources.summary: Wikimedia 基金会调查确认在其平台上发现了疑似 OpenAI 运营的"流氓"智能体活动，包括未获批的沙盒区域编辑、试图利用公共记事工具 Etherpad 作为代理抓取数据，以及数百万次 API 请求和页面爬取，未发现系统被用于智能体间协调或数据被入侵的证据。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Wikimedia调查证实OpenAI rogue agents在Wikipedia等平台留下未授权bot编辑和异常流量，虽未发现数据泄露，但暴露开放平台安全风险。

sources.title_en: Anthropic Subscriptions Offer 5x+ More Value Than OpenAI
sources.title_original: Anthropic Subscriptions Offer 5x+ More Value Than OpenAI
sources.summary: SemiAnalysis 通过逐项测量用量表变化，估算各订阅计划的 API 等价价值，结论是在中端模型档位 Anthropic 订阅的价值约为 OpenAI 的 5 倍。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: SemiAnalysis 测试 Anthropic、OpenAI 等订阅计划后指出，Anthropic 订阅仅占收入 10% 却消耗超 40% 推理算力，使 blended revenue per MW 降约 $36M，并解释同一 $200/月 Claude plan 的价值如何随模型与工作负载变化。

sources.summary: Anthropic 工程师 Felix Rieseberg 说明 Cowork 的新旧架构差异：旧版在云端推理、在用户电脑上运行本地 VM，磁盘、电池和性能开销大，合上笔记本工作就停止。新版把模型推理和 VM 都移到云端，每个会话有独立沙盒，桌面应用只负责文件访问等需要本机设备的工具调用，官方认为这解决了手机使用、保持工作运行和电池消耗等问题。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Felix Rieseberg称新版Cowork把模型推理和VM移入云端，每会话独立sandbox，本地文件访问由桌面应用执行；旧版VM在本地耗电池且合盖即停。

sources.title: Reflection的Beam成为除中国以外能力最强的开放权重模型 / Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China
sources.title_zh: Reflection的Beam成为除中国以外能力最强的开放权重模型
sources.title_en: Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China
sources.title_original: Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China
sources.summary:
Reflection has released Beam, its first open-weight model. The mixture-of-experts system activates just 23 billion of its 501 billion parameters per token and aims to match GLM 5.2 on coding and reasoning while using three to four times less compute. The strategy against Chinese open-weight rivals like Deepseek and Qwen is efficiency over raw performance.

sources.title_original: Researchers stretch LeCun's JEPA AI into a universal world model that works from physics to biology
sources.summary:
Researchers at PhAI Labs have expanded Yann LeCun's JEPA architecture to work across seven fields, from robotics to biomedicine. The effort also produced a liver cancer treatment candidate that showed promise in lab tests, though the study doesn't establish whether it could become an actual therapy.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇值得读，因为 OpenAI 为应对 EU AI Act 推出 textGrain 文本水印，API 默认关闭可全球选择启用，数周内为欧盟符合条件 ChatGPT 和 Codex 文本输出加水印，检测器先向获批研究者开放，1% 误报率下心理学类 200 token 段落检出约 80%，400 token 约 95%。
